exercises.title: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: ↑ to 50 lb. You hit 45 lb x 12,12 at RPE 8 — that's the top of the dumbbells, so from here progress by reps (8 → 12). Control down, drive up.

exercises.title: Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Hold 30 lb — 9/10/10 at RPE 9-10 last time. Own 3x12 before going up. Slight elbow bend, wide arc, squeeze at the top.

exercises.title: Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: ↑ to 30 lb — clean 12/12/12 at 25 lb, RPE 8-9. Overhead, elbows tucked, full stretch behind the head.

exercises.title: Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Evened out to 35 lb across — the 30/40/30 ladder gave you 10/5/12, which is just one bad set. Bench ~30°, press slightly back over the eyes.

exercises.title: Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Hold 10 lb on all three — 15 lb only bought you 6 reps at RPE 10. Lead with the elbows, no swing, 12-15 clean.

exercises.title: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: 25 lb. You only got 1 set in last time — the win here is all three. Seated, ribs down, no arch.

exercises.title: Skullcrusher (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: 25 lb. Elbows stay put, lower to the forehead, no flaring.

exercises.title: Russian Twist (Weighted)
exercises.notes: Core circuit — Russian twist, ~10 lb, controlled rotation (20 total, 10/side).

exercises.title: Plank
exercises.notes: Plank — glutes tight, no hip sag.

exercises.title: Dead Bug
exercises.notes: Dead bug — 12 per side, low back pinned to the mat, slow.

exercises.title: Stretching
exercises.notes: Cool-down ~5 min: Doorway pec stretch 30s/side (forearm on the frame, step through) · Overhead triceps stretch 30s/side (elbow up, gentle pull) · Cross-body shoulder stretch 30s/side · Child's pose with arms long 45s · Neck side stretch 30s/side.
